registry: TASCO Compression Opportunity Taxonomy & Capability Mapping Registry v1
dataset_independence_contract: shape definitions and mechanical detectors are frozen from D3-E1 (prereg 55494bce) and MUST be applied unchanged to any external validation dataset; shapes discovered later are labeled post-hoc-discovered and validated only on the NEXT dataset

sources.shape_definitions: D3-E1 external census (15K Thoughtworks sessions, prereg 55494bce, commit fde05652)
sources.mechanical_compressibility: D3-E2 E13 decomposition (b8dfc2d9) + D3-E3 repeat-class census (b8a41cdf) + D3-E4 RDS replay (fe0706b9)
sources.online_evidence: D3-E5 A/B (3d593b06) + D3-E6 mechanism audit (53a4a820) + D3-E7 power design (6ac31a3f)

support_levels.COVERED: existing shipped TASCO capability mechanically and safely handles the shape
support_levels.COVERED_CANDIDATE: frozen candidate primitive (RDS, default OFF) handles it; production coverage pending capability qualification
support_levels.PARTIAL: existing capability addresses a subset of the shape
support_levels.CONDITIONAL: capability exists but triggers only on narrower morphology; exposure/risk gates apply
support_levels.GAP_SEMANTIC: opportunity requires semantic folding not implemented (future primitive)
support_levels.UNSAFE: content is decision-critical downstream; compression risks information-loss compensation
support_levels.LOW_VALUE: mechanically compressible but volume/incidence too small to justify handling

abcde_classes.A: Existing-capability compressible (shipped or frozen-candidate primitive fits)
abcde_classes.B: Compressible but unsupported (needs new semantic primitive)
abcde_classes.C: Opportunity exists but unsafe/high-risk (downstream information dependence)

tasco_capabilities.name: Repeated Delivery Suppression

shapes.reason: RDS cumulative folding; D5 lint-family positives support real savings

shapes.name: overlapping_file_read

shapes.reason: slice/extractive read compression addresses overlapping ranges but not purpose-built for range-diff

shapes.name: same_search
shapes.definition_frozen: search-class command with same query params >=2 times
shapes.reason: incidence 0.5% in observed universe; search large-outputs already 100% covered by quick_grep (overlap=1.0)

shapes.name: large_test_success
shapes.definition_frozen: test command, observation >=3000 chars, explicit pass
shapes.reason: passing-test repetition ZERO in D3-E1/E6 (outputs change after edits); incidence 0.4%

shapes.name: large_test_failure
shapes.definition_frozen: test command, observation >=3000 chars, explicit fail
shapes.reason: failing-test detail is decision-critical during fix; D5 test-fix pairs show compensation risk; folding requires information-fidelity gates

shapes.name: large_lint_output

shapes.reason: P5 lint-rule aggregation + RDS both effective; D5 lint-fix 10/12 pairs positive

shapes.name: large_build_output
shapes.reason: incidence 0.01% in observed universe; no runnable build toolchain in pinned substrates

shapes.name: repeated_validation
shapes.reason: structurally sparse (0.11%); existing validation_delta covers when present

shapes.name: large_diagnostic
shapes.reason: largest payload but HIGH exposure; D2-E7 task-level negative; E6 shows diagnostic content is decision-core; requires re-derivation-risk handling before compression

shapes.name: large_output_near_terminal
shapes.definition_frozen: observation >=2000 chars in last 25% of trajectory with <=3 subsequent observations
shapes.mechanical_compressibility: LOW (mechanical dedup median 3.5%; structure: diff-like 37.4%, unstructured 22.6%, table 17.8%, test-case-list 17.7%)
shapes.reason: E13 rejected for mechanical compression (D3-E2); semantic structural folding (diff->file summaries, test-list->counts) is an unimplemented future primitive requiring information-fidelity gates

shapes.name: output_followed_by_reread
shapes.definition_frozen: non-shell observation followed by same-path read within <=3 assistant turns
shapes.reason: RDS path-group folding covers; read repeat-suppression partial

shapes.name: output_followed_by_rederivation
shapes.definition_frozen: same normalized command re-executed within <=3 assistant turns

mapping_matrix_note: rows = natural shapes; columns = TASCO capabilities; cells = fit (full/partial/—); support_level and abcde_class per shape above

coverage_summary.basis: per-shape incidence from D3-E1 15K census; session-level A-E union distribution to be computed by the FROZEN detectors at external-validation time (A0 forbids re-scanning)
headline_findings: A-class (existing/frozen-candidate coverage) shapes carry the highest combined incidence (E2/E3/E14 each ~0.62-0.67)
B-class (semantic gap) = E13 late-trajectory large output: 53.25% incidence, LOW exposure, mechanical dedup only 3.5%
C-class (unsafe) = E12 large diagnostic (60.11% incidence, 8.0K median, HIGH exposure) + E7 large test failure
D-class shapes are individually real but sparsely incidents (<=0.5%)
E-class E9 build output effectively absent from observed universe

external_validation_protocol.step1: apply FROZEN detectors unchanged to next dataset (candidate: NVIDIA Open-SWE-Traces sample 20K-50K)
external_validation_protocol.step2: compute per-shape incidence/payload/exposure + session-level A-E union distribution + COC/SOC metrics
external_validation_protocol.step3: any new shape discovered = post-hoc-discovered, validated only on the dataset after next

metrics_defined.COC: covered safe-compressible bytes / all identified safe-compressible bytes
metrics_defined.SOC: sessions with >=1 supported opportunity / sessions with >=1 qualified compression opportunity
metrics_defined.capability_gap: natural opportunity with no current safe primitive
